title: Quad-SPI NOR flash controller with execute-in-place: AXI4 read window (quad 0x6B / single 0x0B, stream kept open across bursts) and a register command port
features: The flash-host role that the QSPI_top target does not cover: boot and code flash of the SoC.
XIP: AXI4 reads of the window (INCR / FIXED / WRAP, any length, AxSIZE 0..2) read the flash at addr[23:0], bytes little-endian in a word.
QUAD = 1 uses 0x6B (quad output fast read), QUAD = 0 uses 0x0B (fast read); 8 dummy clocks either way.
The read stays open after a burst: a burst starting at the next word continues it without a new command (XIP_CMDS counts commands, XIP_BEATS beats).
SCLK stops while RREADY is low, so a stalled reader never loses data. AXI writes get SLVERR.
Command port: one single-bit flash command with an optional 24-bit address, 0..4 bytes out of PC_WDATA and 0..4 bytes into PC_RDATA (byte 0 in bits 7:0).
SPI mode 0; half an SCLK period is DIV + 1 clocks.

regs.name: CFG
regs.desc: XIP read mode and SCLK timing

regs.name: PC_WDATA
regs.desc: Command port: bytes to send, byte 0 (bits 7:0) first

fields.desc: run the command in PC_CTRL; ignored while busy

regs.name: PC_RDATA
regs.desc: Command port: bytes read by the last command, byte 0 in bits 7:0

fields.desc: a command is pending or running

sequence: Write CFG (DIV, QUAD for the flash part); XIP reads work from then on.
Flash command: PC_ADDR and PC_WDATA if used, PC_CTRL, CMD.pc_start, wait for PC_DONE, read PC_RDATA.
Program: 0x06 write enable, then 0x02 with the address and up to 4 bytes, then poll 0x05 status until WIP is 0. Erase: 0x06, then 0x20 with the address.
notes: The AXI4 subordinate port (s_*) and the flash pins (sclk, csn, io[3:0]) pass through the wrapper unchanged.
A command closes the open XIP stream and waits for an XIP burst in progress; XIP waits for the command. IO2 / IO3 (WP#, HOLD#) are driven high outside the quad data phase.
